title: Audio Recording Reference Level for Post-Production of Motion-Picture Related Materials
scope: This guideline specifies the audio recording reference level for intra- and inter-studio operations concerned with motion-picture post-production audio recording on both sprocketed and nonsprocketed analog and digital magnetic and photographic materials.

outline.title: EG9-2005 “Audio Recording Reference Level for Post Production of Motion-Picture Related Materials” has been replaced by the revision of RP155-2014, “Reference Levels for Analog and Digital Audio Systems”.
